pages.text: ORSA RELAY ARCHIVE$(br)Item 1 of 3$(br2)RECORDS RETENTION SCHEDULE R-1$(br2)Issued on instruction of the Council, session 1.$(br2)Distribution: Council members only.
pages.title: Retention Schedule

pages.text: Categories designated for continuation:$(br2)- Genetic reference library$(br)- Language corpora$(br)- Orbital correction archive$(br)- Selected persons (see Annex C)$(br2)Annex C is not attached.
Categories not listed above are not designated for continuation.$(br2)Staff receiving inquiries about category placement should not acknowledge them.$(br2)END OF ITEM
ORSA RELAY ARCHIVE$(br)Item 2 of 3$(br2)CONTINUITY COUNCIL$(br)Session 1$(br)Minutes (partial)$(br2)Recovered from relay cache. Speaker names withheld at source.
pages.title: Council Minutes

pages.text: MEMBER: The schedule lists libraries, seed stock, the correction archive. Where are the people?$(br2)CHAIR: People are a category.$(br2)MEMBER: Which people?$(br2)CHAIR: Annex C.
MEMBER: Annex C is blank.$(br2)CHAIR: Annex C is not blank. It is not attached.$(br2)[Motion to adopt Schedule R-1. Carried. One abstention, not recorded.]
Closing remarks, the Chair:$(br2)"I don't know if mankind will endure.$(br)But we've already decided what will continue in its name."$(br2)[Session closed.]
CARRIER CHANGE$(br)Not an automated relay.$(br2)"...hello? Hello. This is Cydonia relay, night desk. You're on the old ORSA handshake. Nobody has used that code since the surface went quiet."
pages.title: Reply

pages.text: "I ran your badge. It comes back flagged. There's a protocol on it I don't have clearance to open.$(br2)It doesn't say deceased. It doesn't say evacuated. It just says active."
"I'm not supposed to answer this channel. I'm answering.$(br2)If you can hear me: we were told nobody was left down there.$(br2)We were told a lot of things."$(br2)[Carrier lost.]
